title: [self-tests/helpers] truncate: characterization test for the helper truncate at its edges
body:
Target: PeaceG03/PeaceAI-Workspace

add a characterization test for truncate in peaceai/self-tests/helpers/text.ts: truncate edges
- truncate("abcd", 1) is "…"
- truncate("abcd", 4) is "abcd"
- truncate("abcd", -2) is ""
- truncate("", 3) is ""

(Builder pre-file, TEST_CASE_EXISTING, public-test-case-existing-v1): Peace's task (source: peace). The existing helpers test does not cover max 1, an exact fit, a negative max or empty text; this pins them. Self-zone task on PeaceAI-Workspace: one new peaceai/self-tests/helpers/*.test.ts file only. No gate, grading, approval, leak, rule or workflow file is touched. A box dry-run on PeaceAI-Workspace c7ba0a5 (Workspace main, Node 22) built exactly one candidate (public-test-case-existing-v1); a local Job B run graded it COUNTS (the new test passes on the current code and fails with truncate stubbed); with all five new tests of this batch: typecheck ok, npm test 17/17, test:self 5/5, test:tools 1077/1078 (only the box-only m48 snapshot test). Disjoint file: each task in this batch creates its own new test file. Expected COUNTS.)
